Solutions

An ecosystem for the entire electoral cycle.

Six solutions covering in-person and remote voting, polling station management, vote counting, logistics operations and voter information.

BUEElectronic Single Ballot

Electronic Single Ballot system for in-person elections. It combines the speed of electronic voting with the backing of a physical ballot.
